About Us

A Community Concert Series

Absolute Music brings world-class live performance to our community — intimate concerts in the warm, welcoming spaces of Congregation Beth Ami in Santa Rosa.

From the elegance of classical chamber music to the smoky swing of 1930s Paris jazz to the exuberant brass of a full big band, each concert is a chance to experience extraordinary music up close.
